description: Context baseline with no added safety margin.

asi.hypothesis: The existing estimator is the control; measure asymmetric underestimation loss before changing production behavior.
asi.checks: executor context tests and typecheck passed

description: Add a 128-token estimate margin.

asi.hypothesis: A small fixed margin should reduce provider-serialization underestimation without changing the estimator shape.
asi.result: Primary and holdout loss improved; holdout threshold misses reached zero.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 256 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: A larger margin may remove more residual underestimation while keeping early-compaction mistakes bounded.
asi.result: Primary loss improved again and holdout threshold misses stayed at zero; three training threshold false positives were observed.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 384 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: 384 tokens may cover the remaining request-shape residual at the stock threshold.
asi.result: Best optimization score among accepted safety candidates, zero threshold misses on both splits, and three training false positives.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 512 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: A larger margin could further reduce underestimation.
asi.rollback_reason: It exceeded the three false-positive safety cap and was worse than 384 on the optimization split.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 384 and validate it in the full executor and integration suites.

description: Admission baseline against the frozen synthetic corpus.

asi.hypothesis: The existing classifier should establish the policy error profile before changing regexes.
asi.result: One hyphenated substantial-work false negative and one direct negation false positive.

description: Cover hyphenated multiple-concerns work and changing/modifying/editing/writing negation forms.

asi.hypothesis: Normalize the two observed lexical edge cases without broadening the substantial-work policy.
asi.result: Zero optimization and holdout errors; focused admission tests and typecheck passed.

description: Stock-Pi composition baseline with an Autoresearch-shaped extension follow-up.

asi.hypothesis: The existing extension-source guard should prevent an Autoresearch follow-up from entering automatic Prewalk assessment.
asi.result: Real agent-loop characterization passed with one provider turn and no prewalk_assess entry.

description: Remove the extension-source guard as a composition candidate.

asi.hypothesis: Allowing extension-sourced messages into automatic admission might simplify composition.
asi.rollback_reason: The integration test immediately admitted the Autoresearch-shaped follow-up and persisted prewalk_assess.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the fail-closed guard; do not move composition policy into host correlation.

description: Tool-driven baseline confirming the accepted 384-token context-estimate margin.

asi.hypothesis: The accepted 384-token margin will reproduce the frozen optimization and holdout scores with zero threshold false negatives under the actual Autoresearch runner.
asi.result: The exact frozen metrics reproduced and all backpressure checks passed.

description: Context candidate with no added safety margin; reproduced the expected worse score and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: Removing the margin would show whether the accepted calibration still beats the stock estimator under the active runner.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate worsened the primary and holdout scores and failed the focused tests because the expected 384-token safety behavior disappeared.
asi.next_action_hint: Let log_experiment restore the 384-token baseline, then test the 128-token candidate.

description: Context candidate with a 128-token safety margin; it improved on zero margin but remained worse than the accepted 384-token baseline and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 128-token margin might preserve most of the safety improvement at lower early-compaction cost.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate's optimization and holdout scores were both worse than 384, and the exact-margin checks rejected the candidate.
asi.next_action_hint: Let Autoresearch restore 384, then test 256 tokens.

description: Context candidate with a 256-token safety margin; it improved over smaller margins but remained worse than 384 and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 256-token margin might approach the accepted loss while avoiding unnecessary early compaction.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate remained worse on both optimization and holdout scores and failed the focused tests that pin the accepted 384-token behavior.
asi.next_action_hint: Let Autoresearch restore 384, then test 512 tokens for the safety-cap tradeoff.

description: Context candidate with a 512-token safety margin; it reduced underestimation but exceeded the false-positive safety cap, was worse than 384 on optimization, and failed exact-margin tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 512-token margin might reduce underestimation enough to justify its early-compaction cost.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate had five optimization threshold false positives against a cap of three, a worse primary score than 384, and failed the exact-margin tests.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the restored 384-token margin and move to the admission segment.

description: Tool-driven baseline confirming the accepted automatic-admission classifier.

asi.hypothesis: The accepted admission regexes will reproduce zero optimization and holdout errors under the actual Autoresearch runner.
asi.result: The exact frozen admission metrics reproduced and all active-segment checks passed.

description: Former automatic-admission classifier; scorer reproduced 5 optimization and 1 holdout weighted errors, while the wrapper's default checks missed the segment override and a manual admission check found the two expected regression failures.

asi.hypothesis: The former regexes should reproduce the known hyphenated-work miss and direct negation false positive.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate failed the actual admission test file in two cases; the initial wrapper check was invalid because AR_SEGMENT was not inherited by the separate checks process.
asi.next_action_hint: Let Autoresearch restore the accepted regexes and use an explicit in-command admission check for the next baseline.

description: Post-rollback admission baseline with the segment-specific checks explicitly executed in-command.

asi.hypothesis: The accepted regexes and the exact admission test file should pass after the former-classifier rollback.
asi.result: All 16 admission tests, the frozen optimization scorer, the holdout scorer, and typecheck passed with zero errors.

description: Tool-driven composition baseline with the extension-source guard retained.

asi.hypothesis: The existing fail-closed extension-source guard will keep an Autoresearch-shaped follow-up out of automatic Prewalk without lifecycle violations.
asi.result: The composition test and explicit segment checks passed with zero lifecycle violations.

description: Composition candidate removing the extension-source guard; the real agent-loop test admitted the Autoresearch-shaped follow-up and failed.

asi.hypothesis: Allowing extension-sourced messages into automatic admission might simplify composition.
asi.rollback_reason: The composition test persisted a prewalk_assess entry for the extension follow-up, causing one lifecycle violation and a failing test.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the fail-closed extension-source guard; do not move composition policy into host-event correlation.

description: Final no-change composition control; the accepted fail-closed boundary reproduced zero lifecycle violations without overfitting or adding production behavior.

asi.hypothesis: With all production candidates exhausted, the accepted extension-source guard should remain the stable composition boundary under a fresh runner invocation.
asi.rollback_reason: The control matched the existing best metric rather than improving it; no source change was proposed or retained.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop at the 20-run campaign ceiling and preserve the accepted context, admission, and composition decisions.

description: Clean context-search baseline at the accepted 384-token margin on the train split.

asi.hypothesis: The non-mutating margin evaluator should reproduce the accepted 384-token context behavior on the frozen train split while leaving production and exact-margin tests untouched.
asi.result: Train baseline measured 9163 ppm, the scorer passed syntax and cross-checks, and the active checks passed.

description: Train-only 288-token context margin; it was worse than the 384 baseline without improving threshold safety.

asi.hypothesis: A smaller nearby margin might reduce overestimation while retaining enough protection against underestimation.
asi.rollback_reason: Train weighted error rose from 9163 to 9205 and no threshold metric improved.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the clean 384 baseline and test the next nearby margin.

description: Train-only 320-token context margin; it was a slight regression against 384 and did not improve safety counts.

asi.hypothesis: A 320-token margin might be a lower-cost near-optimum than 384.
asi.rollback_reason: Train weighted error was 9164 versus the 384 baseline at 9163, with identical threshold counts.

description: Train-only 352-token context margin; it is the current train leader by 6 ppm, but the gain is far below the 1% promotion threshold and does not change production.

asi.hypothesis: A 352-token margin may be a nearby train optimum while preserving the existing threshold safety counts.
asi.result: Train error improved from 9163 to 9157, only 0.07%; retain as a research finalist, not as a production change, pending validation.

description: Train-only 416-token context margin; it was worse than both the 352 research finalist and the accepted 384 production baseline.

asi.hypothesis: A modestly larger margin might reduce residual underestimation without crossing the safety cap.
asi.rollback_reason: Train weighted error rose to 9183, with no threshold safety improvement over the 352 finalist.

description: Train-only 448-token context margin; it was worse than the 352 research finalist and the accepted 384 production margin.

asi.hypothesis: A larger margin might improve asymmetric loss by further reducing underestimation.
asi.rollback_reason: Train weighted error rose to 9210 and safety counts were unchanged.

description: Train-only 480-token context margin; it was worse than the 352 finalist and exceeded the three-false-positive safety cap even on train.

asi.hypothesis: A 480-token margin might be the largest useful nearby safety margin before early-compaction errors dominate.
asi.rollback_reason: Train weighted error rose to 9252 and threshold false positives increased to four, above the safety cap.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop the broad nearby search; validate 352 and 384 rather than spending runs on more train-only guesses.

description: Validation comparison for the 352-token context finalist; it improves validation loss with zero threshold mistakes but remains below the 1% promotion threshold relative to train.

asi.hypothesis: The small train improvement at 352 should reproduce on the separate validation split without introducing threshold misses.
asi.result: Validation error was 9047 with zero threshold false positives or false negatives; the gain is still too small to justify production change before holdout.

description: Validation comparison for the accepted 384-token context margin; it beats the 352 finalist on validation with zero threshold mistakes.

asi.hypothesis: The existing 384-token production margin should generalize at least as well as the tiny train-leading 352 candidate on validation.
asi.result: 384 scored 8959 versus 9047 for 352, with zero validation threshold false positives and false negatives; retain 384 as the selected candidate.

description: Single post-selection holdout reveal for the selected 384-token context margin; holdout confirmed zero threshold mistakes and was not used to choose a candidate.

asi.hypothesis: The validation-selected 384-token margin should retain zero threshold false negatives on the untouched holdout.
asi.result: Holdout weighted error was 14356 with zero threshold false positives and false negatives; the holdout was revealed only after selection.
asi.rollback_reason: This was an evaluation-only holdout reveal, not a production candidate improvement.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep production at 384 and move to the independent admission robustness corpus.

description: Independent admission-robustness train baseline for the accepted classifier.

asi.hypothesis: The frozen robustness corpus should expose only the intended new negation gap on train while the original 16-case admission suite remains green.
asi.result: Train weighted error was 4 from four new negation false positives; no must-admit misses, all 16 original tests, and typecheck passed.

description: Admission robustness candidate covering direct no-change negation forms; train errors fell from 4 to 1 while original tests stayed green.

asi.hypothesis: A narrow fail-closed pattern for do-not/without making, any, or code changes should remove the new negation false positives without broadening admission.
asi.result: Train weighted error fell to 1; the remaining train false positive is the separate with-no-code-changes variant. Original admission tests and typecheck passed.
